protocol.status: Post-hoc lifecycle follow-up: original NY boundary retest was positive in both accounts; tighter-stop Fibonacci variants worsened recent results. All years reused.
protocol.budget: One fixed design; no holding-time or target sweep
protocol.hypothesis: Allowing the existing3R bracket up to24hours may retain continuation profits that the cash-close liquidation cuts short, while avoiding months of funding

strategy.name: ny_or_retest_24h
strategy.entry_and_bracket: Exactly the original NY first-retest route, whole-opening-range stop with0.25 frozen ATR buffer, fixed3R target from signal close,1.5 modeled net reward floor
strategy.clock: Identical New York09:30-10:00 weekday range,10:00-13:00 entry bars, IANA DST and previous completed4h EMA50 trend
strategy.maximum_holding: At first15m close at or beyond24 elapsed hours after actual entry, submit market exit at next open. No16:00 liquidation. Friday positions may carry into Saturday.
strategy.busy_behavior: Discard signals while in a position. No queued reversal. After flat, a later crossing in that day's entry window may arm its first eligible setup. One setup per NY date while eligible.

protocol.execution: Unchanged0.25% modeled account risk,95% notional cap,max1BTC,.001 step,.07% fee eachside,2ticks slip,.25ATR gap sizing allowance,5m stop-first bracket paths and actual carried-position funding
protocol.publication: Retain all failures, unchanged gates. Passing qualifies only for an experimental prototype; reused data and native/venue/prospective limitations remain. No optimized fallback timeout.
